Because the fable nonce is published only after close, the atlas audit can verify each derivation and a shared text is provable as copied. The three words are derived from a 194 bit value mixing the epoch seed with the identity key, so no two keys ever receive the same triple. That is 23 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
